channel.title: Installing Waydroid
channel.description: I am trying to install waydroid but there seems to be a kernel issue. I get a message that binder node vnd binder is not found. I have tried to mount it manually but get the message unknown file system type "binder". I would be grateful for any advice on how to deal with this issue, or at least to know whether or not it is possible to install waydroid. I realise it probably reduces security, but I am using a separate usb stick just for this and just want to get Signal and Whats app up and running.
